key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF produced the highest hardness.
engineering_relevance: For WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, HVAF is a promising choice when both sliding-wear and corrosion resistance are priorities.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compare coating microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction, and volume wear rate.
Evaluate corrosion resistance and examine wear-track damage mechanisms.
evidence_signal: HVAF showed a wear rate of (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), versus (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for uncoated steel, and the lowest coating corrosion current density at 1.75±0.02 µA/cm².
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test or corrosion-exposure conditions, limiting direct extrapolation to service environments.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
